recommendation.fetch: NCBI SRA Lite from the NCBI host (anonymous ranged GETs, 8 streams) to job /tmp, else full .sra from public S3, else ENA fastq.gz; decode the local file, never stream through VDB
recommendation.format: .1fg v1: 32,768-pair chunks, CBUMI u64 + R2 2-bit slot + exception list, zstd frames (nvCOMP), CRC32C per section, no qualities
recommendation.codec: zstd level 3 (level 1 if CPU-node time dominates, raw if bytes are free); keep the per-block barcode sort (+17-37% bytes without it)
recommendation.gpu_batch: 128-256 chunks per nvCOMP batch (320-600 M pairs/s decode)
recommendation.status: prototype, measured on 2 samples (+1 fetched run for the CPU-node stage); identity 0 mismatches on 66.6 M and 121.8 M pairs
